name: Taylor Yarkosky

items.text: Yarkosky was arrested for driving under the influence in 2004 and 2005, when he was in his twenties. During his 2022 House campaign he wrote that he regretted putting others in danger and had not had a drink in years. Opposition mailers had raised the arrests.
items.why: The arrests are old, he acknowledged them himself, and the page shows no conviction or finding, so they have no clear bearing on any criterion about conduct in office or use of the position.

for_review: The owner-sites search (one search) found nothing about Yarkosky on alexjoneslive.com, stewpeters.com, ryandawson.org or infowars.com. Not read: court records of the 2004/2005 DUI cases, so whether there were convictions is unconfirmed. Possible items I did not add because the evidence was only opinion or did not meet the bar: (1) A Substack author (Steve Edward Farley, an opinion/advocacy source) says a Lake County judge ordered Yarkosky on Aug 7, 2026 to reimburse Advanced Pier Technology LLC $20,000 for ownership interests wrongfully withheld. I could not read the order. Someone should pull it from the Lake County Clerk and read it for a possible self-dealing finding. (2) The March 2025 WFTV report on a $4,000 refund check that bounced from Advanced Plumbing Technology, which Yarkosky co-owns. I read it. He said the account was closed by mistake, the customer was paid within two days of WFTV calling, and WFTV did not report any finding of wrongdoing. (3) The same Substack makes other claims, including a 2016 lawsuit by his then-wife over the pier company. I did not read or verify them.
